tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a free anonymous account and get an API key (aa_...). No email or personal data needed. Store the key; pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key> or append ?key=<key> to the MCP URL.

tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: Recent SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company (8-K material events with item explanations, 10-Q/10-K, Form 4 insider trades, 13D/G, ...). Free, no account needed. Links go to sec.gov.

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Latest FX rate (ECB reference, daily) or crypto price (Coinbase public rates). Stock quotes are not provided (licensing) – use a price alert instead.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Account info: default channels, webhook signing secret, alert counts.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Set default notification channels (used by alerts without their own channels) and/or label.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create one alert, evaluated server-side so your agent does not need to stay running: kind=price (stock / crypto / fx threshold) or kind=filing (notify on each new SEC filing of a company you follow).

tools.name: upsert_alerts
tools.description: Bulk create/update alerts keyed by external_id – sync a whole watchlist (e.g. recalculated buy/sell levels + filing watches) in one call. Changing a target re-arms a triggered alert. replace_all=true deletes your alerts not in the list.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List your alerts with status (active / triggered / paused / expired), data_status and last trigger.

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Update one alert by id or external_id (target, condition, forms, note, channels, repeat, status=active to re-arm or paused).

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Delete one alert by id or external_id.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Your recent alert events (price conditions met, new SEC filings) with delivery results. Poll this if you have no webhook: pass since=<ISO time of your last check>.

tools.name: test_notification
tools.description: Send a test notification to given channels (or your default channels).

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Permanently delete your account, alerts and events.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: create_account, get_account · Public sink: create_account, get_account, create_alert, list_events, test_notification · Destructive: delete_alert, delete_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: create_account, get_account · Public sink: create_account, get_account, create_alert, list_events, test_notification · Destructive: delete_alert, delete_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
